get.description: Lists assets from the asset registry. Filter by exchange, tradability and quote coin; sort by symbol; 50 rows a page.

401.description: The API key is missing, unknown or disabled (invalid_api_key, invalid_token).

402.description: Not enough credits, or a credit budget or call limit was reached (insufficient_credits).

403.description: The package of the key may not call this endpoint, or the endpoint is in preview (package_not_allowed, endpoint_preview).

429.description: A rate or call limit was reached; the Retry-After header says how many seconds to wait.

parameters.name: exchange
parameters.description: Exchange name to filter by: BINANCE, KUCOIN, HUOBI, KRAKEN, GATEIO or OKX. Omit to include every exchange.

parameters.name: canTrade
parameters.description: When true, only assets the exchange currently allows trading; when false, only the others. Omit for both.

parameters.name: quote
parameters.description: Quote coin to filter by, for example USDT. Omit for every quote coin.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Field to sort by: symbol (default); a minus sign in front sorts high to low.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page to return, from 1. Default 1.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Rows per page, 1 to 50. Default 50.

parameters.name: market
parameters.description: Only this market: eqtusa, crypto, dax or fxs.

parameters.name: syms
parameters.description: Only these symbols, comma-separated, up to 50, any case.

parameters.name: side
parameters.description: buy or sell.

parameters.name: horizon
parameters.description: How long the call was followed: 6h, 24h, 72h, 7d or 30d.

parameters.name: conf
parameters.description: How sure FinGraph was: VHigh, High, Med, Low, VLow or None.

parameters.name: outcome
parameters.description: won (Win, TP1, TP2, TP3), lost (Loss, SL), flat (the rest), or one exact result such as TP1 or SL.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Closed on or after this day (UTC), such as 2026-11-01.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Closed on or before this day (UTC), such as 2026-11-20.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: closedAt, calledAt, returnPct or sym; a minus sign sorts high to low. Default -closedAt.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page to return, from 1. Default 1.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Rows per page, 1 to 50. Default 50.

error.description: Machine-readable code, such as invalid_api_key, insufficient_credits or package_not_allowed.

lane.description: On limit refusals: the setting that governs the limit that was hit.

limit.description: On limit refusals: the value that was hit.

catag.description: On per-category limits: the category tag.

tier.description: On per-category limits: the package tier of the caller.

ticker_count.description: Number of listed tickers on the exchange.

avg_chg_pct.description: Average 24-hour price change across those tickers, in percent; null when none is known.

total_quot_vol.description: Sum of the 24-hour quote volume across those tickers; null when none is known.

id.description: Asset id; pass it to the asset detail call.

base.description: Base currency of the pair, for example BTC.

quot.description: Quote currency of the pair, for example USDT.

status.description: Trading status reported by the exchange.

can_trade.description: True when the exchange currently allows trading.

spot_allowed.description: True when spot trading is allowed.

margin_allowed.description: True when margin trading is allowed.

id_.description: Numeric id of the pattern detector.

key.description: Short key of the pattern detector.

direction.description: What the pattern suggests: BULLISH, BEARISH, NEUTRAL or CONTEXT (depends on the prior trend).

tf_bias.description: Time-frame the pattern is weighted for: INTRADAY, SWING or MACRO.

conf_min.description: Minimum confidence a detection needs to count; null when none is set.

enabled.description: True while the detector is switched on.

lane.description: Market the quote comes from: crypto, stocks, forex or pairs.

currency.description: Currency the price is quoted in.

chg_pct.description: Price change over one day, in percent.

bid_price.description: Best bid price, when the lane provides one.

ask_price.description: Best ask price, when the lane provides one.

volume.description: Traded volume; volume_basis says what it counts.

volume_basis.description: What volume counts: shares (stocks), usd (crypto, 24-hour value), quote (exchange pairs, quote-currency value); null for forex.

last_price.description: Last traded price in the quote currency.

chg_pct.description: Price change over the last 24 hours, in percent.

high_price.description: Highest price over the last 24 hours.

low_price.description: Lowest price over the last 24 hours.

quot_vol.description: Traded volume over the last 24 hours, in the quote currency.

base_vol.description: Traded volume over the last 24 hours, in the base currency.

in_exchange.description: True while the pair is listed on the exchange.

last_traded_id.description: Id of the last trade the exchange reported.

total_trades.description: Number of trades over the last 24 hours.
